results.body:
new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/reset"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("reset")
.error(
        error()
                .withResetConnection(true)
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/both"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("both")
.error(
        error()
                .withDelay(new Delay(TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS, 1))
                .withDropConnection(true)
                .withResetConnection(true)
                .withStreamError(8L)
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/bytes"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("bytes")
.error(
        error()
                .withResetConnection(true)
                .withResponseBytes(new Base64Converter().base64StringToBytes("SGVsbG8="))
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/off"),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        0
)
.withId("off")
.error(
        error()
                .withDropConnection(true)
                .withResetConnection(false)
);
